card.name: Scattered mid-name and linking words
card.fires_on: Mostly the middle of a proper name (Higginson, Hichami, Stigall) and the word 'and' in 'children, adolescents, and young adults'. Also a few single linking words in running text.

modes.label: Inside surnames
modes.description: Partway through a surname after an initial letter, such as H-ig-ginson or St-ig-all.
modes.example: she wrote a letter to H<<ig>>ginson beginning, Are you too deeply

modes.label: 'and' in age group list
modes.description: The word 'and' before 'young adults' in the antidepressant warning about children and adolescents.
modes.example: Increased risk of suicidal thinking and behavior in children, adolescents,<< and>> young adults taking antidepressants.

modes.label: Other linking words
modes.description: A single word after a noun or phrase in ordinary text, such as 'engines' or 'for'.
modes.example: Webmasters and content providers began optimizing sites for search<< engines>> in the mid-1990
